page_title: AI Agents for Customer Support | WorkBot by WorkHub

summary.name: WorkBot
summary.one_liner: WorkBot is a no-code AI chatbot and agent platform that automates customer support across live chat, voice, and email.
use_cases: Automating website FAQs and order tracking
Handling inbound and outbound support calls with a voice agent
Triaging and drafting replies to support emails
Booking appointments through a chat assistant
Escalating complex tickets to human agents with context
summary.what_it_does: WorkBot provides AI agents for text chat, voice calls, and email support, which the page says can be deployed on websites, mobile apps, live chat systems, inboxes, and voice platforms. It automates repetitive tasks such as FAQs, order tracking, appointment bookings, and billing workflows. The page says it can escalate conversations to live human agents with context preserved. It lists integrations with Google Calendar, CRM, Shopify, and Slack, and claims support for over 50 languages. The builder is described as no-code with prebuilt templates.
notable: No-code builder with prebuilt templates and customizable flows
Voice agent for inbound and outbound calls, plus email triage agent
Integrations with CRM, Shopify, Slack, and Google Calendar
Supports over 50 languages with automatic localization
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page beyond a 'Try free' prompt and 'No Credit Card Required' note
Performance claims such as 75% cost reduction and 60-70% instant resolution are testimonial-style marketing figures without a stated source
Page does not specify plan limits or which regulations it complies with
